content:
sophie: FYI i'm going to push a small config-only change now. Reduce kv_cache_ttl from 600 -> 300s and per-tenant batch_size 32 -> 24 for 1h. Also raise routing.weight_floor for low-priority to 0.02. Change window 10:30-11:30 PT. No model bumps.

deploy-bot: [deploy queued] config-service:config-only/quiet-kvcache-2026-03-21 queued by sophie

sophie: canary -> 5% traffic to canary pool (no model nor infra changes). plan: 5% -> 20% -> 100% with a 30m hold at 20%.

marco: do we need to pin model versions for fallback?

sophie: No model pin needed; fallback is purely config revert. If we see perf regressions we'll roll config back.

ryan: please add observability triggers: p95 +200ms OR error rate >0.5% sustained over 5m.

elaine: thread to collect quick rollback steps?

sophie: Rollback snippet (one-liner):
```bash
kubectl patch configmap config-service -n infra -p '{"data":{"kv_cache_ttl":"600","batch_size":"32","routing_weight_floor":"0.01"}}'
```

deploy-bot: [start canary] canary rollout -> 5% (stage 1). Automated checks: infra-health, p95, error-rate, kvcache-hit.

monitoring-bot: alert-rule created: svc/config-service latency-p95 threshold=200ms duration=5m owner=@elaine

deploy-bot: canary 5% -> OK, moving to 20% after 2m verification

observability: slight p95 bump ~+15ms vs baseline, p99 flat, error rate 0.02% (within tolerances)

ryan: lgtm from infra side, ok to advance to 100% after the 30m hold if no regressions

sophie: holding at 20% for full 30m now. monitoring on watch.

observability: during hold p95 returned to +5ms, p99 unchanged, KV hit-rate down ~3% but no increase in token latency.

deploy-bot: promoted to 100% at 11:05 PT (change window still open until 11:30)

observability: post-promote telemetry: p95 baseline, overall cost estimate down ~7% on token-serving for this route (quick estimate), no errors spiking

marco: nice. leaving note for release notes: config-only tweak - kv_cache_ttl reduced to 300s, per-tenant batch_size lowered to 24, routing.weight_floor for low-priority increased to 0.02; canary 5->20->100 with 30m hold.

sophie: added to release notes and closing window. thanks all :tada:
